reassembly: Use ordered person-claims/mentions/inboundClaims entries by index, full person-record base and unique source-unit table; governing block structure/order is complete across all parts. No old verdict candidates appear here.

value.zh: 陵始降時，忽忽如狂，自痛負漢，加以老母系保宮。
value.en: When Ling first surrendered, he was restless as if mad, pained at having failed Han, and moreover his old mother was detained in the protection palace.
value.literal: When Ling first surrendered, he was restless as if mad, himself pained at having failed Han, and moreover his old mother was detained in the protection palace.

value.zh: 子卿不欲降，何以過陵！
value.en: Ziqing does not wish to surrender—how are you better than Ling!
value.literal: Ziqing does not wish to surrender—how does he surpass Ling!

value.zh: 且陛下春秋高，法令無常，大臣無罪夷滅者數十家。
value.en: Moreover the emperor is advanced in years, laws and orders are erratic, and several tens of families of guiltless great ministers have been exterminated root and branch.
value.literal: Moreover the emperor's years are advanced, laws and orders are without constancy, and great ministers without guilt exterminated root and branch number several tens of families.

value.zh: 安危不可知，子卿尚復誰為乎！」
value.en: Safety and danger cannot be known—for whom do you still act, Ziqing!"
value.literal: Safety and danger cannot be known—Ziqing, for whom do you still act!"

value.zh: 武曰：「武父子無功德，皆為陛下所成就，位列將，爵通侯，兄弟親近，常願肝腦塗地。
value.en: Wu said, "Wu father and son had no merit—all was accomplished by Your Majesty. We ranked as generals, were enfeoffed as full marquises, and as close brothers constantly wished to lay down our lives.
value.literal: Wu said: "Wu father and son had no merit or virtue—all were accomplished by Your Majesty; we ranked as generals, enfeoffed as full marquises, brothers close and near, and constantly wished to smear liver and brain on the ground.

value.zh: 今得殺身自效，雖斧鉞、湯鑊，誠甘樂之！
value.en: Now to be able to give my life in service, though it be axe and halberd or boiling cauldron, I would truly and gladly accept it!
value.literal: Now obtaining to kill the body and devote effect, though axe and halberd, boiling cauldron, truly I would gladly enjoy it!

value.zh: 臣事君，猶子事父也。
value.en: A subject serving his lord is like a son serving his father.
value.literal: A subject serving his lord is like a son serving his father.

value.zh: 子為父死，無所恨。
value.en: A son dying for his father has nothing to regret.
value.literal: A son dying for his father has nothing to regret.

value.zh: 願勿復再言！」
value.en: Please do not speak of this again!"
value.literal: I wish you would not speak again!"

value.zh: 陵與武飲數日，復曰：「子卿壹聽陵言！」
value.en: Ling drank with Wu for several days, then again said, "Ziqing, please wholly heed my words!"
value.literal: Ling drank with Wu for several days, then again said: "Ziqing, wholly listen to Ling's words!"

value.zh: 武曰：「自分已死久矣，王必欲降武，請畢今日之歡，效死於前！」
value.en: Wu said, "I have long considered myself dead. If you must have Wu surrender, please finish today's pleasure and I will die before you!"
value.literal: Wu said: "I myself have judged myself dead long ago. If the king must have Wu surrender, please finish today's pleasure and I will devote death before you!"

value.zh: 陵見其至誠，喟然歎曰：「嗟乎，義士！
value.en: Ling saw his utmost sincerity and sighed with emotion, "Alas, a man of righteousness!
value.literal: Ling saw his utmost sincerity and sighed with emotion: "Alas, a man of righteousness!

value.zh: 陵與衛律之罪上通於天！」
value.en: Ling's and Wei Lü's guilt reaches up to Heaven!"
value.literal: Ling's and Wei Lü's guilt reaches up to Heaven!"

value.zh: 因泣下沾衿，與武決去。
value.en: Thereupon tears fell and soaked his collar; he took leave of Wu and departed.
value.literal: Thereupon tears fell and soaked his collar; he took leave of Wu and departed.

value.zh: 賜武牛羊數十頭。
value.en: He bestowed on Wu several tens of cattle and sheep.
value.literal: He bestowed on Wu several tens of cattle and sheep.

value.zh: 後陵復至北海上，語武以武帝崩。
value.en: Later Ling again came to the North Sea coast and told Wu that Emperor Wu had died.
value.literal: Later Ling again came to the North Sea coast and told Wu that Emperor Wu had died.

value.zh: 武南鄉號哭歐血，旦夕臨，數月。
value.en: Wu faced south and wailed until he vomited blood; morning and evening he faced south in mourning for several months.
value.literal: Wu faced south and wailed, vomiting blood; morning and evening he faced the direction in mourning for several months.

value.zh: 及壺衍鞮單于立，母閼氏不正，國內乖離，常恐漢兵襲之，於是衛律為單于謀，與漢和親。
value.en: When Chanyu Huyanshidi was established, the queen mother's position was irregular, the state was divided within, and they constantly feared Han troops would strike; thereupon Wei Lü schemed for the Chanyu and sought peace kinship with Han.
value.literal: When Chanyu Huyanshidi was established, the mother's yanzhi was not correct, the state within was divided and estranged, and they constantly feared Han troops would strike them; thereupon Wei Lü schemed for the Chanyu and made peace kinship with Han.

value.zh: 漢使至，求蘇武等，匈奴詭言武死。
value.en: Han envoys arrived and sought Su Wu and the rest; the Xiongnu falsely claimed Wu was dead.
value.literal: Han envoys arrived and sought Su Wu and the rest; the Xiongnu falsely said Wu was dead.

value.zh: 後漢使復至匈奴，常惠私見漢使，教使者謂單于，言：「天子射上林中，得雁，足有系帛書，言武等在某澤中。」
value.en: Later Han envoys again reached the Xiongnu; Chang Hui privately met the Han envoy and taught him to tell the Chanyu, saying, "The emperor shot in Shanglin Park and obtained a wild goose; on its foot was tied a silk message saying Wu and the rest are in a certain marsh."
value.literal: Later Han envoys again reached the Xiongnu; Chang Hui privately saw the Han envoy and taught the envoy to tell the Chanyu, saying: "The Son of Heaven shot in Shanglin Park and obtained a wild goose; on its foot was tied a silk book saying Wu and the rest are in a certain marsh."

value.zh: 使者大喜，如惠語以讓單于。
value.en: The envoy was greatly pleased and, as Hui had said, reproached the Chanyu.
value.literal: The envoy was greatly pleased and, as Hui's words directed, reproached the Chanyu.

value.zh: 單于視左右而驚，謝漢使曰：「武等實在。」
value.en: The Chanyu looked left and right in alarm and apologized to the Han envoy, "Wu and the rest truly still live."
value.literal: The Chanyu looked left and right in alarm and apologized to the Han envoy: "Wu and the rest truly exist."

value.zh: 乃歸武及馬宏等。
value.en: Thereupon he returned Wu and Ma Hong and the rest.
value.literal: Thereupon he returned Wu and Ma Hong and the rest.

value.zh: 馬宏者，前副光祿大夫王忠使西國，為匈奴所遮；
value.en: Ma Hong had formerly been deputy to Palace Illustrious Grandee Wang Zhong on a mission to western states and was intercepted by the Xiongnu;
value.literal: Ma Hong was formerly deputy to Palace Illustrious Grandee Wang Zhong on a mission to western states and was intercepted by the Xiongnu;

value.zh: 忠戰死，馬宏生得，亦不肯降。
value.en: Zhong died in battle; Ma Hong was taken alive and also would not surrender.
value.literal: Zhong died in battle; Ma Hong was taken alive and also would not surrender.

value.zh: 故匈奴歸此二人，欲以通善意。
value.en: Therefore the Xiongnu returned these two men, wishing thereby to signal good intent.
value.literal: Therefore the Xiongnu returned these two men, wishing thereby to open good intent.

value.zh: 於是李陵置酒賀武曰：「今足下還歸，揚名於匈奴，功顯於漢室，雖古竹帛所載，丹青所畫，何以過子卿！
value.en: Thereupon Li Ling set out wine to congratulate Wu, saying, "Now your lordship returns home, your fame raised among the Xiongnu and your merit displayed in the Han house—even what ancient bamboo and silk record and paintings depict, how could they surpass Ziqing!
value.literal: Thereupon Li Ling set out wine to congratulate Wu, saying: "Now your lordship returns home, fame raised among the Xiongnu, merit displayed in the Han house—even what ancient bamboo and silk record and red and green paint, how could they surpass Ziqing!

value.zh: 陵雖駑怯，令漢貰陵罪，全其老母，使得奮大辱之積志，庶幾乎曹柯之盟，此陵宿昔之所不忘也。
value.en: Ling is dull and timid, but if Han would pardon Ling's guilt, preserve his old mother, and let him exert the will long accumulated from great disgrace, perhaps like the covenant at Cao Ke—this Ling has never forgotten from of old.
value.literal: Ling though dull and timid—if Han would pardon Ling's guilt, preserve his old mother, and let him be able to exert the long-accumulated will of great disgrace, perhaps like the Cao Ke covenant—this Ling from old nights has not forgotten.

value.zh: 收族陵家，為世大戮，陵尚復何顧乎！
value.en: His clan was gathered and exterminated—the age's great punishment—what does Ling still care for!
value.literal: His clan was gathered and exterminated—an age's great punishment—what does Ling still care for!

value.zh: 已矣，令子卿知吾心耳！」
value.en: It is done—let Ziqing know my heart!"
value.literal: It is done—let Ziqing know my heart!"

value.zh: 陵泣下數行，因與武決。
value.en: Ling wept several lines of tears and thereupon took leave of Wu.
value.literal: Ling wept several lines of tears and thereupon took leave of Wu.

value.zh: 單于召會武官屬，前已降及物故，凡隨武還者九人。
value.en: The Chanyu summoned and assembled Wu's official subordinates; counting those who had earlier surrendered and those who had died, in all nine followed Wu back.
value.literal: The Chanyu summoned and assembled Wu's official subordinates; those who had earlier surrendered and those who had died—in all nine followed Wu back.

value.zh: 既至京師，詔武奉一太牢謁武帝園廟，拜為典屬國，秩中二千石，賜錢二百萬，公田二頃，宅一區。
value.en: Once they reached the capital, an edict had Wu offer a grand sacrificial victim and visit Emperor Wu's park temple; he was appointed Director of Dependent States at rank of middle two thousand dan, bestowed two million cash, two qing of public fields, and one residence.
value.literal: Once they reached the capital, an edict had Wu offer one grand sacrificial victim and visit Emperor Wu's park temple; he was appointed Director of Dependent States, rank middle two thousand dan, bestowed two million cash, two qing of public fields, and one residence.

value.zh: 武留匈奴凡十九歲，始以強壯出，及還，鬚髮盡白。
value.en: Wu remained among the Xiongnu nineteen years in all; he had gone forth in his prime, and on return his beard and hair were all white.
value.literal: Wu remained among the Xiongnu in all nineteen years; he went forth in his prime strength, and on return his beard and hair were all white.

value.zh: 霍光、上官桀與李陵素善，遣陵故人隴西任立政等三人俱至匈奴招之。
value.en: Huo Guang, Shangguan Jie, and Li Ling had always been on good terms; they sent Ling's old acquaintance Ren Lizheng of Longxi and three others together to the Xiongnu to summon him.
value.literal: Huo Guang, Shangguan Jie, and Li Ling had always been on good terms; they sent Ling's old acquaintance Ren Lizheng of Longxi and three others together to the Xiongnu to summon him.

value.zh: 陵曰：「歸易耳，丈夫不能再辱！」
value.en: Ling said, "Returning is easy, but a man cannot suffer disgrace twice!"
value.literal: Ling said: "Returning is easy—but a man cannot suffer disgrace twice!"

value.zh: 遂死於匈奴。
value.en: Thereupon he died among the Xiongnu.
value.literal: Thereupon he died among the Xiongnu.

value.zh: 夏，旱。
value.en: In summer, there was drought.
value.literal: In summer, drought.

value.zh: 秋，七月，罷榷酤官，從賢良、文學之議也。
value.en: In autumn, the seventh month, the wine monopoly offices were abolished, following the counsel of the worthy and learned.
value.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the wine monopoly offices were abolished, following the counsel of the worthy and learned.

value.zh: 武帝之末，海內虛耗，戶口減半，霍光知時務之要，輕徭薄賦，與民休息。
value.en: At the end of Emperor Wu's reign the realm was depleted and household registers were halved; Huo Guang knew the essentials of the times, lightened corvée and reduced levies, and gave the people rest.
value.literal: At the end of Emperor Wu's reign, within the seas was empty and depleted and household registers were halved; Huo Guang knew the essentials of the times' affairs, lightened corvée and reduced levies, and gave the people rest.

value.zh: 至是匈奴和親，百姓充實，稍復文、景之業焉。
value.en: By this time the Xiongnu made peace kinship, the common people were prosperous, and the realm slightly restored the achievements of Emperors Wen and Jing.
value.literal: By this time the Xiongnu made peace kinship, the common people were full and solid, and they slightly restored the enterprises of Emperors Wen and Jing.

value.zh: 詔以鉤町侯毋波率其邑君長、人民擊反者有功，立以為鉤町王。
value.en: An edict, because Marquis of Goujing Wubo had led his town chiefs, elders, and people to strike rebels with merit, established him as King of Goujing.
value.literal: An edict because Marquis of Goujing Wubo led his town chiefs and elders and people to strike rebels with merit established him as King of Goujing.

value.zh: 賜田廣明爵關內侯。
value.en: Tian Guangming was bestowed the noble rank of Marquis within the Passes.
value.literal: Tian Guangming was bestowed the noble rank of Marquis within the Passes.

value.zh: 春，正月，泰山有大石自起立；
value.en: In spring, the first month, on Mount Tai a great stone by itself stood up;
value.literal: In spring, the first month, on Mount Tai a great stone by itself stood up;

value.zh: 上林有柳樹枯僵自起生；
value.en: in Shanglin a willow tree, dead and stiff, by itself rose and lived;
value.literal: in Shanglin a willow tree, dead and stiff, by itself rose and lived;

value.zh: 有蟲食其葉成文，曰「公孫病已立」。
value.en: insects ate its leaves forming characters saying "Gongsun Bingyi established."
value.literal: insects ate its leaves forming characters saying "Gongsun Bingyi established."

value.zh: 符節令魯國眭弘上書，言：「大石自立，僵柳復起，當有匹庶為天子者。
value.en: Staff-and-tally Director Sui Hong of Lu submitted a memorial, saying, "The great stone stood by itself, the stiff willow revived—there ought to be a commoner who becomes Son of Heaven.
value.literal: Staff-and-tally Director Sui Hong of Lu submitted a memorial, saying: "The great stone stood by itself, the stiff willow revived—there ought to be a commoner who becomes Son of Heaven.

value.zh: 枯樹復生，故廢之家公孫氏當復興乎？
value.en: A dead tree revives—perhaps the Gongsun clan of the abolished house should revive?
value.literal: A dead tree revives—perhaps the Gongsun clan of the abolished house should revive?

value.zh: 漢家承堯之後，有傳國之運，當求賢人禪帝位，退自封百里，以順天命。」
value.en: The House of Han succeeds after Yao and has the fortune to transmit the state—one should seek a worthy man and yield the imperial throne, retire and enfeoff oneself with a hundred li, to accord with Heaven's mandate."
value.literal: The House of Han succeeds after Yao and has the fortune to transmit the state—one should seek a worthy man and yield the imperial throne, retire and enfeoff oneself with a hundred li, to accord with Heaven's mandate."

value.zh: 弘坐設妖言惑眾伏誅。
value.en: Hong was punished for setting up freakish words to delude the masses and was executed.
value.literal: Hong was punished for setting up freakish words to delude the masses and was executed.

value.zh: 匈奴單于使犁汙王窺邊，言酒泉、張掖兵益弱，出兵試擊，冀可復得其地。
value.en: The Xiongnu Chanyu sent King Liwu to spy on the border, saying Jiuquan and Zhangye troops were growing weaker—send troops to try striking, hoping to recover their territory.
value.literal: The Xiongnu Chanyu sent King Liwu to spy on the border, saying Jiuquan and Zhangye troops were growing weaker—send troops to try striking, hoping to recover their territory.

value.zh: 時漢先得降者，聞其計，天子詔邊警備。
value.en: At this time Han first obtained surrenderers and heard their plan; the Son of Heaven issued an edict the border to warn and prepare.
value.literal: At this time Han first obtained surrenderers and heard their plan; the Son of Heaven issued an edict the border to warn and prepare.

value.zh: 後無幾，右賢王、犁汙王四千騎分三隊，入日勒、屋蘭、番和。
value.en: Not long after, the Wise King of the Right and King Liwu with four thousand horsemen divided into three columns and entered Rile, Wulan, and Fanhe.
value.literal: Not long after, the Wise King of the Right and King Liwu with four thousand horsemen divided into three columns and entered Rile, Wulan, and Fanhe.

value.zh: 張掖太守、屬國都尉發兵擊，大破之，得脫者數百人。
value.en: The Administrator of Zhangye and Commandant of the Dependent State raised troops and struck, greatly defeated them; those who escaped were several hundred.
value.literal: The Administrator of Zhangye and Commandant of the Dependent State raised troops and struck, greatly defeated them; those who escaped were several hundred.

value.zh: 屬國義渠王射殺犁汙王，賜黃金二百斤，馬二百匹，因封為犁汙王。
value.en: King Yiqu of the Dependent State shot and killed King Liwu; he was granted two hundred jin of gold and two hundred horses, and thereby enfeoffed as King Liwu.
value.literal: King Yiqu of the Dependent State shot and killed King Liwu; he was granted two hundred jin of gold and two hundred horses, and thereby enfeoffed as King Liwu.

value.zh: 自是後，匈奴不敢入張掖。
value.en: From this afterward the Xiongnu did not dare enter Zhangye.
value.literal: From this afterward the Xiongnu did not dare enter Zhangye.

value.zh: 燕、蓋之亂，桑弘羊子遷亡，過父故吏侯史吳，後遷捕得，伏法。
value.en: In the Yan and Gaishan disorder, Sang Hongyang's son Qian fled, passed his father's old clerk Marquis-History Wu; later Qian was captured and punished by law.
value.literal: In the Yan and Gaishan disorder, Sang Hongyang's son Qian fled, passed his father's old clerk Marquis-History Wu; later Qian was captured and punished by law.

value.zh: 會赦，侯史吳自出繫獄。
value.en: An amnesty occurred; Marquis-History Wu of himself came out of imprisonment.
value.literal: An amnesty occurred; Marquis-History Wu of himself came out of imprisonment.

value.zh: 廷尉王平、少府徐仁雜治反事，皆以為「桑遷坐父謀反而侯史吳臧之，非匿反者，乃匿為隨者也」，即以赦令除吳罪。
value.en: Director of Justice Wang Ping and Privy Treasurer Xu Ren jointly tried the rebellion affair; all thought "Qian sat under his father's plotting rebellion and Marquis-History Wu hid him—not hiding a rebel but hiding a follower"—and thereby by the amnesty edict removed Wu's crime.
value.literal: Director of Justice Wang Ping and Privy Treasurer Xu Ren jointly tried the rebellion affair; all thought "Qian sat under his father's plotting rebellion and Marquis-History Wu hid him—not hiding a rebel but hiding a follower"—and thereby by the amnesty edict removed Wu's crime.

value.zh: 後侍御史治實，以「桑遷通經術，知父謀反而不諫爭，與反者身無異。
value.en: Later the attendant censor investigated the facts and held that "Qian mastered the classics, knew his father plotted rebellion yet did not remonstrate and contend—in person no different from rebels.
value.literal: Later the attendant censor investigated the facts and held that "Qian mastered the classics, knew his father plotted rebellion yet did not remonstrate and contend—in person no different from rebels.

value.zh: 侯史吳故三百石吏，首匿遷，不與庶人匿隨從者等，吳不得赦。」
value.en: Marquis-History Wu was formerly an official of three hundred bushels who first hid Qian—not equal to commoners hiding followers—Wu could not receive amnesty."
value.literal: Marquis-History Wu was formerly an official of three hundred bushels who first hid Qian—not equal to commoners hiding followers—Wu could not receive amnesty."

value.zh: 奏請覆治，劾廷尉、少府縱反者。
value.en: The memorial requested renewed trial and impeached the Director of Justice and Privy Treasurer for indulging rebels.
value.literal: The memorial requested renewed trial and impeached the Director of Justice and Privy Treasurer for indulging rebels.

value.zh: 少府徐仁，即丞相車千秋女婿也，故千秋數為侯史吳言；
value.en: Privy Treasurer Xu Ren was Chancellor Che Qianqiu's son-in-law; therefore Qianqiu repeatedly spoke for Marquis-History Wu;
value.literal: Privy Treasurer Xu Ren was Chancellor Che Qianqiu's son-in-law; therefore Qianqiu repeatedly spoke for Marquis-History Wu;

value.zh: 恐大將軍光不聽，千秋即召中二千石、博士會公車門，議問吳法。
value.en: fearing Grand General Guang would not listen, Qianqiu then summoned officials of the middle two thousand bushels and erudites to meet at the Public Carriage Gate and discuss and question Wu's law.
value.literal: fearing Grand General Guang would not listen, Qianqiu then summoned officials of the middle two thousand bushels and erudites to meet at the Public Carriage Gate and discuss and question Wu's law.

value.zh: 議者知大將軍指，皆執吳為不道。
value.en: The discussants knew the Grand General's intent and all held Wu as lawless.
value.literal: The discussants knew the Grand General's intent and all held Wu as lawless.

value.zh: 明日，千秋封上眾議。
value.en: The next day Qianqiu sealed and sent up the collective discussion.
value.literal: The next day Qianqiu sealed and sent up the collective discussion.

value.zh: 光於是以千秋擅召中二千石以下，外內異言，遂下廷尉平、少府仁獄。
value.en: Guang thereupon because Qianqiu on his own authority summoned middle two thousand bushels and below, with outer and inner differing words, sent down Director of Justice Ping and Privy Treasurer Ren to prison.
value.literal: Guang thereupon because Qianqiu on his own authority summoned middle two thousand bushels and below, with outer and inner differing words, sent down Director of Justice Ping and Privy Treasurer Ren to prison.

value.zh: 朝廷皆恐丞相坐之。
value.en: The court all feared the Chancellor would be implicated.
value.literal: The court all feared the Chancellor would be implicated.

value.zh: 太僕杜延年奏記光曰：「吏縱罪人，有常法。
value.en: Grand Coachman Du Yanian submitted a note to Guang, saying, "Officials who indulge criminals have a regular law.
value.literal: Grand Coachman Du Yanian submitted a note to Guang, saying: "Officials who indulge criminals have a regular law.

value.zh: 今更詆吳為不道，恐於法深。
value.en: Now again denouncing Wu as lawless—I fear it is deep in the law.
value.literal: Now again denouncing Wu as lawless—your subject fears it is deep in the law.

value.zh: 又，丞相素無所守持而為好言於下，盡其素行也。
value.en: Moreover, the Chancellor by nature has nothing he holds to and speaks kindly to those below—that is fully his usual conduct.
value.literal: Moreover, the Chancellor by nature has nothing he holds to and speaks kindly to those below—that is fully his usual conduct.

value.zh: 至擅召中二千石，甚無狀。
value.en: As for on his own authority summoning middle two thousand bushels—that is very lawless.
value.literal: As for on his own authority summoning middle two thousand bushels—that is very lawless.

value.zh: 延年愚以為丞相久故及先帝用事，非有大故，不可棄也。
value.en: Yanian foolishly thinks the Chancellor is long in office and served the late emperor—without a great cause he cannot be abandoned.
value.literal: Yanian foolishly thinks the Chancellor is long in office and served the late emperor—without a great cause he cannot be abandoned.

value.zh: 間者民頗言獄深，吏為峻詆；
value.en: Of late the people have often said the prisons are harsh and officials make severe accusations;
value.literal: Of late the people have often said the prisons are deep and harsh, and the officials make severe slander;

value.zh: 今丞相所議，又獄事也，如是以及丞相，恐不合眾心，群下讙嘩，庶人私議，流言四布。
value.en: now what the Chancellor discusses is again a prison matter; if it extends to the Chancellor in this fashion, I fear it will not accord with popular sentiment—the officials will clamor, commoners will gossip privately, and rumors will spread everywhere.
value.literal: now what the Chancellor discusses is again a prison matter; if in this fashion it extends to the Chancellor, I fear it will not accord with the hearts of the multitude—the ranks below will clamor, commoners will privately discuss, and floating slander will spread in all directions.

value.zh: 延年竊重將軍失此名於天下也。」
value.en: Yannian privately fears the General will lose this reputation throughout the realm."
value.literal: Yannian privately fears the General will lose this reputation under Heaven."

value.zh: 光以廷尉、少府弄法輕重，卒下之獄。
value.en: Guang, because the Director of Justice and the Minister Steward had manipulated the law regarding severity, finally sent them to prison.
value.literal: Guang, because the Director of Justice and the Minister Steward manipulated the law regarding severity, finally sent them to prison.

value.zh: 夏，四月，仁自殺，平與左馮翊賈勝胡皆要斬。
value.en: In summer, the fourth month, Ren committed suicide; Ping and Left Governor of Anding Jia Shenghu were all executed by waist chop.
value.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Ren committed suicide; Ping and the Left Governor of Anding Jia Shenghu were all executed by waist chop.

value.zh: 而不以及丞相，終與相竟。
value.en: Yet he did not extend the matter to the Chancellor; in the end he still came to a final contest with the Chancellor.
value.literal: Yet he did not extend it to the Chancellor; in the end he still contended with the Chancellor to the finish.

value.zh: 延年論議持平，合和朝廷，皆此類也。
value.en: Yannian's discussions were even-handed and harmonized the court—all were of this sort.
value.literal: Yannian's discussions and judgments were even-handed and harmonized the court—all were of this sort.

value.zh: 冬，遼東烏桓反。
value.en: In winter, the Wuhuan of Liaodong rebelled.
value.literal: In winter, the Wuhuan of Liaodong rebelled.

value.zh: 初，冒頓破東胡，東胡餘眾散保烏桓及鮮卑山為二族，世役屬匈奴。
value.en: Initially Modun defeated the Eastern Hu; the Eastern Hu remnant peoples scattered and took refuge on the Wuhuan and Xianbei mountains as two peoples, for generations subject to corvée and allegiance to the Xiongnu.
value.literal: Initially Modun broke the Eastern Hu; the Eastern Hu's remaining masses scattered and took refuge on Wuhuan and Xianbei mountains as two peoples, generation after generation subject to corvée and allegiance to the Xiongnu.

value.zh: 武帝出破匈奴左地，因徙烏桓於上谷、漁陽、右北平、遼東塞外，為漢偵察匈奴動靜。
value.en: When Emperor Wu campaigned and broke the Xiongnu's left territory, he moved the Wuhuan beyond the passes of Shanggu, Yuyang, Right Beiping, and Liaodong to spy on Xiongnu movements for Han.
value.literal: Emperor Wu went out and broke the Xiongnu's left territory; he thereupon moved the Wuhuan to beyond the passes of Shanggu, Yuyang, Right Beiping, and Liaodong, to spy on the Xiongnu's movements for Han.

value.zh: 置護烏桓校尉監領之，使不得與匈奴交通。
value.en: He appointed a Colonel Protecting the Wuhuan to oversee them, so they could not communicate with the Xiongnu.
value.literal: He set a Colonel Protecting the Wuhuan to oversee and lead them, so they could not communicate with the Xiongnu.

value.zh: 至是，部眾漸強，遂反。
value.en: By this time their tribes had gradually grown strong, and they rebelled.
value.literal: At this time their tribal masses gradually grew strong, and they thereupon rebelled.

value.zh: 起上章涒灘，盡玄黓閹茂，凡三年。
value.en: From Shangzhang Tuntan through Xuanji Yanmao—three years in all.
value.literal: From Shangzhang Tuntan through Xuanji Yanmao; three years in all.

value.zh: 春，正月，上始行幸甘泉，郊泰畤，三月，行幸河東，祠后土。
value.en: In spring, the first month, the emperor first traveled to Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the Great Altar; in the third month he traveled to Hedong and sacrificed to the Queen of Earth.
value.literal: In spring, the first month, the emperor first undertook the journey to favor Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the Great Altar; in the third month he undertook the journey to favor Hedong and sacrificed to the Queen of Earth.

value.zh: 上頗修武帝故事，謹齋祀之禮，以方士言增置神祠；
value.en: The emperor largely revived Emperor Wu's ways, carefully observing fasting and sacrifice; on fangshi advice he added shrines;
value.literal: The emperor largely restored Emperor Wu's practices, carefully observing fasting and sacrificial rites; on the word of fangshi he added divine shrines;

value.zh: 聞益州有金馬、碧雞之神，可醮祭而致，於是遣諫大夫蜀郡王褒使持節而求之。
value.en: hearing that Yizhou held the spirits of the Golden Horse and Green Cock, whom libation could summon, he dispatched Remonstrance Grandee Wang Bao of Shu as envoy bearing credentials to seek them.
value.literal: hearing that in Yizhou were the spirits of the Golden Horse and Green Cock, whom libation-sacrifice could summon, he thereupon dispatched Remonstrance Grandee Wang Bao of Shu commandery as envoy bearing credentials to seek them.

value.zh: 資治通鑑第033卷
value.en: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 33.
value.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 33.

value.zh: 初，董仲舒說武帝，以「秦用商鞅之法，除井田，民得賣買，富者田連阡陌，貧者亡立錐之地，邑有人君之尊，裡有公侯之富，小民安得不困！
value.en: Earlier, Dong Zhongsun persuaded Emperor Wu: "Qin used Lord Shang's laws, abolished the well-field system, and allowed land to be bought and sold—the rich held fields stretching across paths and moors, the poor had no place to stand an awl; townships held men with a ruler's honor, lanes men with a duke's wealth—how could common people not be distressed!
value.literal: Initially, Dong Zhongsun persuaded Emperor Wu, saying: "Qin used Lord Shang's laws, abolished the well-field system, and allowed the people to sell and buy land—the rich had fields stretching across paths and moors, the poor had no place to stand an awl; in the townships were men with a ruler's honor, in the lanes were men with a duke or marquis's wealth—how could the little people not be distressed!

value.zh: 古井田法雖難卒行，宜少近古，限民名田以贍不足，塞並兼之路；
value.en: Though the ancient well-field law cannot be restored at once, one ought to draw near antiquity, limit registered land to support the needy, and block the path of merger;
value.literal: Though the ancient well-field law is hard to carry out at once, one ought to draw somewhat near antiquity, limit the people's registered land to support the insufficient, and block the path of merger and absorption;

value.zh: 去奴婢，除專殺之威；
value.en: abolish slaveholding and the power of arbitrary killing;
value.literal: remove slave servants and abolish the authority of arbitrary killing;

value.zh: 薄賦斂，省繇役，以寬民力，然後可善治也！」
value.en: lighten taxes, reduce corvée labor, ease the people's burden—only then can there be good governance!"
value.literal: lighten taxes and levies, reduce corvée labor, thereby easing the people's strength—only then can there be good governance!"

value.zh: 及上即位，師丹復建言：「今累世承平，豪富吏民訾數巨萬，而貧弱愈困，宜略為限。」
value.en: When this emperor took the throne, Shi Dan again proposed: "After generations of peace, the powerful and wealthy count their wealth in tens of millions while the poor grow ever weaker—it is fitting to set limits."
value.literal: When this emperor took the throne, Shi Dan again proposed: "Now, after generations of enduring peace, powerful and wealthy officials and people number their wealth in tens of millions, while the poor and weak grow ever more distressed—it is fitting to set some limit."

value.zh: 天子下其議，丞相光、大司空武奏請：「自諸侯王、列侯、公主名田各有限；
value.en: The emperor referred the matter; Chancellor Guang and Grand Minister of Works Wu memorialized: "From feudal kings and princes, ranked marquises, and princesses, registered land should each have a limit;
value.literal: The Son of Heaven sent down their deliberation; Chancellor Guang and Grand Minister of Works Wu memorialized requesting: "From feudal kings and princes, ranked marquises, and princesses, registered land each should have a limit;

value.zh: 關內侯、吏、民名田皆毋過三十頃；
value.en: for marquises within the passes, officials, and common people, registered land must not exceed thirty qing;
value.literal: for marquises within the passes, officials, and common people, registered land must not exceed thirty qing;

value.zh: 奴婢毋過三十人。
value.en: slaves must not exceed thirty persons.
value.literal: slave servants must not exceed thirty persons.

value.zh: 期盡三年。
value.en: A deadline of three years was set.
value.literal: A deadline of three years was set for full compliance.

value.zh: 犯者沒入宮。」
value.en: Violators would have excess property confiscated by the palace."
value.literal: Violators would have their property confiscated into the palace."

value.zh: 時田宅、奴婢賈為減賤，貴戚近習皆不便也，詔書：「且須後。」
value.en: Land, houses, and slaves fell in price; the noble kin and court favorites were all discommoded; an edict said, "For now, wait."
value.literal: At the time the prices of fields, dwellings, and slave servants fell in reduction, and the noble kin and those near the emperor were all discommoded; an edict said: "For now, wait."

value.zh: 遂寢不行。
value.en: Thereupon the measure was shelved and never carried out.
value.literal: Thereupon the measure was shelved and not carried out.

value.zh: 又詔齊三服官：「諸官織綺繡，難成、害女紅之物，皆止，無作輸。
value.en: Another edict to the Three Garment Offices of Qi: "All offices weaving patterned silks and brocades—things hard to finish and harmful to women's work—must stop; produce nothing for delivery.
value.literal: Another edict to the Three Garment Offices of Qi: "All offices weaving patterned silks and brocades—things hard to finish and harmful to women's needlework—are all to stop; do not produce them for delivery.

value.zh: 除任子令及誹謗詆欺法。
value.en: The emperor abolished the statute on gratifying heirs and the statutes on slander, defamation, and fraud.
value.literal: They abolished the statute on gratifying heirs and the statutes on slander, defamation, and fraud.

value.zh: 掖廷宮人年三十以下，出嫁之；
value.en: Palace women of the Palace Domestic Service aged thirty and below were released to marry;
value.literal: Palace women of the Palace Domestic Service aged thirty and below were given in marriage;

value.zh: 官奴婢五十以上，免為庶人，益吏三百石以下俸。」
value.en: official bondmen and bondwomen aged fifty and above were freed as commoners, and salaries for officials ranked at three hundred piculs and below were raised."
value.literal: official male and female slaves fifty and above were freed as commoners, and salaries for officials of three hundred piculs and below were increased."
